## Analysis Summary

The data used in this analysis were obtained from the `filtered area normalized` sheet in the file `HMC-25-047_Lalowski_20052025_TA.xls`

```{r message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# import metabolite abundance data (normalized) 
hmc_df <- read_excel("../data/HMC-25-047_Lalowski_20052025_TA.xls",
                      sheet = "Filtered area normalized",
                      skip = 14) %>% 
            dplyr::select(Compounds, matches("KO|WT"))

# hmc_df %>%
#   dplyr::filter(if_all(.cols = where(is.numeric),
#                        .fns = is.na)) %>%
#   nrow()
# There are 313 metabolites that have NAs for all iPSC and DE samples         

# Filter these out
hmc_df <- hmc_df %>% 
                dplyr::filter(!if_all(.cols = where(is.numeric),
                                     .fns = is.na))

# how many metabolites have all missing values for JUST one condition?
# iPSCs
missing_ipsc <- hmc_df %>% 
                  dplyr::filter(if_all(.cols = contains("PSCs"),
                                       .fns = is.na)) %>%
                  dplyr::pull(Compounds)

# DE
missing_de <- hmc_df %>% 
                  dplyr::filter(if_all(.cols = contains("DE"),
                                       .fns = is.na)) %>%
                  dplyr::pull(Compounds)

# Make a note of these but REMOVE from downstream analysis
# Why? We can perhaps qualitatively say that there is significant differential abundance for these metabolites because they are completely absent in one or the other condition
# However, I am unsure about including them in the imputation process below i.e. what value do we use to impute?
hmc_df <- hmc_df %>% 
            dplyr::filter(!(Compounds %in% c(missing_ipsc, missing_de)))

# count the number of missing values in each row
partially_missing <- hmc_df %>% 
  dplyr::rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(num_na = sum(is.na(c_across(-Compounds)))) %>% # most metabolites have no missing values, but a few have >= 10 metabolites
  dplyr::filter(num_na >= 10) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-num_na) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Compounds,
                      names_to = "sample",
                      values_to = "abundance") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(group = str_extract(sample, "(?<=^\\d{3}\\_).+(?=\\_[:digit:]\\_)")) %>% # extract everything between the first 3 digits followed by an underscore (the look-behind) and the pattern - "underscore-digit-underscore" (the look-ahead)
  dplyr::group_by(Compounds, group) %>% 
  dplyr::count(condition = is.na(abundance)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(condition) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!(Compounds %in% c("ALLANTOIN", "ERYTHRITOL"))) %>% # keep these
  dplyr::select(Compounds) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct(Compounds) %>% 
  dplyr::pull(Compounds)

# Note: 3 out of these 5 metabolites are either completely or nearly completely missing in one of the four groups
# Decision: Make a note of these, but remove them from further analysis
hmc_df <- hmc_df %>% 
            dplyr::filter(!(Compounds %in% partially_missing))

# reshape
hmc_df_t <- hmc_df |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -Compounds,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Compounds,
    values_from = abundance
  )

# Impute remaining missing values using missForest algorithm
hmc_df_t_imp <- missRanger(hmc_df_t, 
                          formula = . ~ . - sample, # using all variables except for sample to perform imputation
                          pmm.k = 5,
                          seed = 42, # ensuring imputation is replicable
                          verbose = 0) # see ?missRanger for the advantages of doing this
# I kept all function defaults except pmm.k, which I set to 5 as was done in the missRanger vignette
# And I also set the seed to 42

# reshape back to un-transposed form
hmc_df_imp <- hmc_df_t_imp |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -sample,
    names_to = "Compounds",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = abundance
  )

# are there any 0 values?
# apply(hmc_df_imp, 2, function(x) sum(x == 0))
# no. Safe to log-transform all values

hmc_df_reshape <- hmc_df_imp %>% 
                    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Compounds,
                                        names_to = "sample",
                                        values_to = "abundance") %>% 
                    dplyr::mutate(tech_rep = str_extract(sample, "inj\\d$")) %>% 
                    dplyr::mutate(bio_rep = str_extract(sample, "[^inj]+"),
                                  bio_rep = str_remove(bio_rep, "\\_$")) %>% 
                    dplyr::relocate(bio_rep, .before = tech_rep)

# make sample metadata df
metadata <- hmc_df_reshape %>% 
              dplyr::select(sample, bio_rep, tech_rep) %>% 
              dplyr::distinct() %>% 
              dplyr::mutate(group = str_extract(sample, "(?<=^\\d{3}\\_).+(?=\\_[:digit:]\\_)"))
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample

# make limma matrix
limma_df <- hmc_df_reshape %>% 
              dplyr::select(sample, Compounds, abundance) %>% 
              tidyr::pivot_wider(
                names_from = sample,
                values_from = abundance
              ) %>% 
              dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), log2)) # log transform

limma_mat <- limma_df[-1] %>% 
              as.matrix()
rownames(limma_mat) <- limma_df$Compounds

# confirm correct order
identical(colnames(limma_mat), rownames(metadata)) # TRUE 
```

### Visualizations
```{r message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# sample distributions
# density plot
limma_mat %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Compounds") %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Compounds,
                      names_to = "sample",
                      values_to = "log2_abundance") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sample = str_remove(sample, "^X")) %>% 
  dplyr::inner_join(metadata, join_by(sample)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(log2_abundance, col = group)) +
  geom_density() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "Sample Distributions for each Time-point",
       y = "")

# median and mean abundance by group
limma_mat %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Compounds") %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Compounds,
                      names_to = "sample",
                      values_to = "log2_abundance") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sample = str_remove(sample, "^X")) %>% 
  dplyr::inner_join(metadata, join_by(sample)) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(group) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(mean_abundance = mean(log2_abundance),
                   median_abundance = median(log2_abundance))

# boxplots
limma_mat %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Compounds") %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Compounds,
                      names_to = "sample",
                      values_to = "log2_abundance") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sample = str_remove(sample, "^X")) %>% 
  dplyr::inner_join(metadata, join_by(sample)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(group, log2_abundance, col = sample)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Sample Distributions for each Time-point",
       y = "")

# PCA plot
hmc_df_t <- limma_mat %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Compounds") %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Compounds,
                      names_to = "sample",
                      values_to = "log2_abundance") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sample = str_remove(sample, "^X")) %>%  
  dplyr::inner_join(metadata, join_by(sample)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(sample, Compounds, log2_abundance) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Compounds,
    values_from = log2_abundance
  )

hmc_mat_t <- as.matrix(hmc_df_t[-1])
rownames(hmc_mat_t) <- hmc_df_t$sample

pca.res_full <- PCA(hmc_mat_t, graph = FALSE)

# Visualize eigenvalues/variances
fviz_screeplot(pca.res_full, addlabels = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 75))

# PCA plot
pca_plot_groups <- fviz_pca_ind(pca.res_full,
             habillage = factor(metadata$group),
             geom = "point",
             addEllipses = TRUE) +
                  labs(title = "Coloured by group")

pca_plot_tech_reps <- fviz_pca_ind(pca.res_full,
             habillage = factor(metadata$bio_rep),
             geom = "point",
             addEllipses = FALSE,
             invisible="quali") + # remove centroid
  labs(title = "Coloured by technical replicate") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
# looks like technical replicates are close to each other

pca_plot_groups / 
  pca_plot_tech_reps +
    plot_annotation(
      tag_levels = "A"
    ) +
    plot_layout(
      axes = "collect"
    )

# heatmap
heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(limma_mat)
rownames(heatmap_mat) <- rownames(limma_mat)

# make column annotation df
annotation_col_df <- tibble::tibble(
  `technical replicate` = metadata$tech_rep,
  group = metadata$group
) %>% data.frame()
rownames(annotation_col_df) <- colnames(heatmap_mat)

# plot heatmap
pheatmap(heatmap_mat,
         scale = "row",
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         annotation_col = annotation_col_df,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         fontsize = 7,
         fontsize_row = 4, 
         main = "Clustering Metabolites and Samples by Correlation")
```

### Differential Abundance Analysis

```{r message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# create design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~0 + group, data = metadata)
# design

# Use duplicateCorrelation to estimate within-sample correlation
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(limma_mat, 
                               design, 
                               block = metadata$bio_rep)
#corfit$consensus.correlation
# 0.71

# fit models
fit <- lmFit(
              limma_mat, 
              design, 
              block = metadata$bio_rep,
              correlation = corfit$consensus.correlation
             )

# create contrast matrix
contrast.matrix <- makeContrasts(
    "iPSC_KO_vs_WT" = groupPSCs_AMOTL2_KO - groupPSCs_WT,
    "DE_KO_vs_WT" = groupDE_AMOTL2_KO - groupDE_WT,
    "WT_DE_vs_iPSC" = groupDE_WT - groupPSCs_WT,
    "KO_DE_vs_iPSC" = groupDE_AMOTL2_KO - groupPSCs_AMOTL2_KO,
    "Interaction" = (groupDE_AMOTL2_KO - groupPSCs_AMOTL2_KO) - (groupDE_WT - groupPSCs_WT),
    levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast.matrix)
efit <- eBayes(fit2)
```

#### iPSC - KO vs WT

```{r message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
topTable(efit, coef = "iPSC_KO_vs_WT",
         number = nrow(limma_mat)) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Compound") %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(P.Value) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 2))) %>% 
  DT::datatable(
    caption = "iPSC - KO vs WT"
  )
```
